description: Responsive design refinement and performance optimization. Ensure all new designs work flawlessly on mobile/tablet, implement touch-friendly interactions, simplify animations on smaller screens, and optimize for Core Web Vitals.
steps: Update css/layout.css responsive breakpoints: refine @media (max-width: 900px) for tablet - adjust hero diagonal clip-path to less aggressive angle, reduce parallax effects, scale down geometric shapes

Enhance @media (max-width: 768px) for mobile: simplify bento grid to single column, remove complex shapes (clip-paths, rotations) on .about-img-frame and .cert-card, reduce animation distances (translateY from 30px to 15px)

Add touch-friendly interactions in js/animations.js: detect touch device using ('ontouchstart' in window), disable magnetic cursor on touch devices, replace hover parallax with tap-to-expand for project cards, increase tap target sizes to minimum 44x44px in css/components.css

Optimize mobile animations: wrap complex animations (particle system, parallax) in window.matchMedia('(min-width: 769px)') check in js files, reduce IntersectionObserver threshold to 0.05 for mobile (faster reveals), decrease stagger delays to 0.05s per element

Implement mobile-specific navigation improvements in css/layout.css and js/main.js: ensure .mobile-nav has smooth slide-in animation (transform: translateY(-100%) to translateY(0)), add body scroll lock when mobile menu open

Performance optimization in js/canvas-bg.js: reduce particle count to 25 on mobile (detect via window.innerWidth), use passive event listeners for all scroll/touch handlers, implement debounce for resize events

Performance optimization in js/3d-avatar.js: lower THREE.js renderer pixel ratio to 1 on mobile (already capped at 2), reduce IcosahedronGeometry detail level to 0 on mobile, implement visibility check to pause rendering when off-screen
Add lazy loading to index.html: add loading='lazy' to all images below fold (all project images, certificates, about images already have it - verify), add decoding='async' to all img tags

CSS performance in css/components.css: add contain: layout style paint to isolated components (.project-card, .service-card, .cert-card) to limit repaint scope, use content-visibility: auto on sections for rendering optimization

Test Core Web Vitals: run Lighthouse audit, target LCP < 2.5s (optimize largest contentful paint - likely hero image), FID < 100ms (already good with delegated events), CLS < 0.1 (add explicit width/height to images, reserve space for dynamic content)
acceptance_criteria: All sections responsive and functional on mobile (375px) and tablet (768px, 900px) breakpoints
Complex shapes and animations simplified on mobile to prevent performance issues
Touch targets meet 44x44px minimum size for buttons and interactive elements
Magnetic cursor and complex parallax disabled on touch devices
Mobile navigation slides in smoothly with body scroll lock when open
Canvas particle count reduced on mobile, all scroll listeners use passive: true
Three.js avatar rendering pauses when off-screen and uses lower detail on mobile
All images use loading='lazy' and decoding='async' below fold
Isolated components use contain CSS property for paint containment
Lighthouse audit shows: Performance > 90, LCP < 2.5s, FID < 100ms, CLS < 0.1
verification: Open http://localhost/Portofolio_Ilham/ on mobile device or Chrome DevTools device emulation
Verify bento grid collapses to single column on mobile
Test touch interactions: tap buttons verify 44x44px size, swipe through sections smoothly
Verify magnetic cursor does not activate on touch device emulation
Open mobile nav and verify body scroll locked and menu slides in
Check DevTools Performance monitor: particle count shows 25 on mobile vs 55 on desktop
Scroll to About section: verify 3D avatar canvas pauses rendering when scrolled off-screen (check THREE.js animation loop)
Verify Network tab shows images load lazily as they enter viewport
Run Chrome DevTools Lighthouse audit (mobile + desktop), verify Performance score > 90
Check Lighthouse Core Web Vitals: LCP < 2.5s, FID < 100ms, CLS < 0.1
